# Nobody signs. The deadline passes (a window of 60 seconds, the shortest that policy.star allows), the run tells the escalation list
# and asks whether to extend. Nobody answers inside the 60 seconds of that question, so the request expires and the item is held.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:ssh-keygen] skip
[!exec:sqlite3] skip
[!exec:flock] skip
[!exec:git] skip
[!exec:sha256sum] [!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

approvalsinit
approvalsfakes
approvalskeys ann
subst home/.approval/config
env HOME=$WORK/home
env APPROVALS_DIR=$WORK/ops
env APPROVALS_WINDOW_SECONDS=60
env APPROVAL_POLL=1

exec sh ops/scripts/submit.sh msa msa.md ann
exec obeereal item add approvals req-1 --title 'Release' --body-file body.txt
exec obeereal run req-1 approvals --workflow ops/workflow.star
stdout 'item req-1 finished'

grep -count=1 '^escalate-req-1 rita' notices.log
grep -count=1 '^remind-req-1-1 ' notices.log
exec sh -c 'sh ops/scripts/audit.sh req-1 - $(jq -r .head home/.approval/certs/req-1.json)'
stdout '\tclosed\t.*\texpired\t'
! stdout '\textended\t'
! stdout '\tapproved\t'
exec sqlite3 state/local.db 'SELECT state FROM items WHERE id = "req-1"'
stdout '^hold$'

-- body.txt --
{"doc":"msa","kind":"release","author":"ann"}
-- msa.md --
The release candidate.
-- home/.approval/config --
NOTIFY_API=http://notify.test
-- home/.approval/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
